summary_en: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS authorized acquisition of up to 200,000 shares (1.9% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥4.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 9, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and implement flexible capital policies.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 8, 2026, SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO., LTD. resolved to acquire up to 200,000 shares of its common stock, representing 1.9% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026. The maximum acquisition amount is set at ¥400 million, with an implied ceiling price of approximately ¥2,000 per share. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 9, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the purpose of this treasury stock acquisition is to enhance capital efficiency and implement flexible capital policies in response to changes in the business environment. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 1,402,081 treasury shares against 10,597,919 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The company notes that execution is not guaranteed, and market conditions may result in partial or complete non-execution of the planned acquisition.
